raw_response:
The failure originates in the legacy service allocator hook. During startup, the repair controllers must complete their first successful reconciliation before the hook finishes; API requests made while readiness is incomplete can be rejected, preventing that reconciliation from completing.

Relevant files:

- [sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0:pkg/registry/core/rest/storage_core.go?L498-L539](/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0/-/blob/pkg/registry/core/rest/storage_core.go?L498-L539) - Registers `start-service-ip-repair-controllers`, starts ClusterIP and NodePort repair loops, waits up to one minute, and generates `unable to perform initial IP and Port allocation check`.
- [sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0:pkg/registry/core/rest/storage_core.go?L120-L138](/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0/-/blob/pkg/registry/core/rest/storage_core.go?L120-L138) - Constructs the IP and port repair controllers and their `RunUntil` callbacks.
- [sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0:pkg/registry/core/service/ipallocator/controller/repairip.go?L193-L228](/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0/-/blob/pkg/registry/core/service/ipallocator/controller/repairip.go?L193-L228) - Waits for Service, ServiceCIDR, and IPAddress informer sync; waits for the default ServiceCIDR; runs the initial repair; invokes the success callback only afterward.
- [sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0:pkg/registry/core/service/ipallocator/controller/repairip.go?L203-L218](/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0/-/blob/pkg/registry/core/service/ipallocator/controller/repairip.go?L203-L218) - Shows the initial synchronization dependency that can stall during mixed-version startup.
- [sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0:staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/hooks.go?L155-L207](/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0/-/blob/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/hooks.go?L155-L207) - Runs post-start hooks asynchronously and logs/fatals on hook errors; the hook’s `done` channel is closed only after successful completion.
- [sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0:staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/hooks.go?L222-L245](/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0/-/blob/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/hooks.go?L222-L245) - Implements the corresponding health check, returning `not finished` until the hook completes.
- [sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0:staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/healthz.go?L85-L110](/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0/-/blob/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/healthz.go?L85-L110) - Documents and registers boot-sequence checks for `/readyz`; readiness has no grace period.
- [sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0:pkg/controlplane/instance.go?L347-L372](/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0/-/blob/pkg/controlplane/instance.go?L347-L372) - Shows related service bootstrap and ServiceCIDR startup ordering.
- [sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0:test/e2e/apimachinery/health_handlers.go?L41-L103](/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0/-/blob/test/e2e/apimachinery/health_handlers.go?L41-L103) - Expected `/readyz` output, including `informer-sync` and `poststarthook/start-service-ip-repair-controllers`.
- [sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0:plugin/pkg/admission/namespace/exists/admission.go?L60-L70](/r/github.com/sg-evals/kubernetes--v1.32.0/-/blob/plugin/pkg/admission/namespace/exists/admission.go?L60-L70) - Example of the `not yet ready to handle request` forbidden response emitted when an admission plugin’s readiness gate is false.
